## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run coverage`
- [ ] `npm run security`
- [ ] Cross-platform impact reviewed

## Privacy review

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal logs, or private configuration were added.
- [ ] Sanitization behavior was considered for any new log-handling code.
